path.description:
String of Object's nested keys. For example, if the object structure is { 'a': {'b': [1, 2]}}
and data for {@link UiSdlEnhancedCardList } is inside 'b', the
path string for it would be 'a.b'. If your key has '.' in it, wrap it in [""]. For example,
if the object is { 'a': {'b.d': [1, 2]}}, the path would be 'a["b.d"]'.
